author: Javipepe
body:
Hello fellow players!

As requested by many of you we have added a subforum for you guys to discuss about anything tournament / event related here, announcing non-official events or discussing about those. Hopefully this will about tournament questions in every subforum.

If you have questions related with events, the topic should go in this subforum.

Have a good day / night / NASA timespan.
Peace!
